title: Service-Recovery Courtesy and Small-Balance Limits — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Two small-amount limits apply to every Hospital Account (Encounter Billing): the largest one-time service-recovery courtesy adjustment per encounter, which depends on the patient class, and the small-balance write-off threshold, which does not. The number of courtesy adjustments a patient may receive is counted per calendar year across all of the patient's encounters.

| Patient class | Service-recovery courtesy maximum per encounter (USD) | Courtesy adjustments per patient per calendar year | Small-balance write-off at or below (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | 25.00 | 1 | 4.99 |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | 25.00 | 1 | 4.99 |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 40.00 | 1 | 4.99 |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 50.00 | 1 | 4.99 |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | 75.00 | 1 | 4.99 |
| Observation Stay Account | 75.00 | 1 | 4.99 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 100.00 | 1 | 4.99 |

## Points of reading

- The courtesy maximum is the ceiling of a single courtesy adjustment on one account of that patient class.
- The yearly count is one courtesy adjustment per patient per calendar year across all of the patient's accounts, whatever their patient class.
- *Write-off threshold (hypothetical balances).* A remaining balance of 4.99 is at the threshold and 5.00 is above it.
